candidates.description: This vector activates on various non-English characters, particularly Hindi script fragments, alongside distinct English suffix components and proper noun prefixes.
This vector activates for Hindi Devanagari characters and subword suffixes.
This feature vector activates strongly on specific Devanagari consonant-vowel conjuncts involving the letter 'ष' (sha).
This vector activates on Hindi script characters and Devanagari Unicode sequences.
This vector represents common suffixes and endings in Hindi words written in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes, sub-word syllables, and phonetic fragments ending in the retroflex 'टर' or dental 'तर' sound.
This vector represents Hindi character sub-word tokens and conjunct consonants.
This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi words containing the consonant 'स' (sa) and related sub-word tokens.
These tokens represent Hindi verb suffixes and inflections related to gender, tense, and aspect.
These tokens represent dependent vowel signs (matras) and diacritics used in North Indic scripts like Hindi and Devanagari.
